_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.defaultConstraints: UNIQUE REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: UNIQUE REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "patients" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notification_slot" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "sex" TEXT NULL, "age" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("notification_slot"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_routines" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "wake_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "breakfast_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lunch_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dinner_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sleep_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("patient_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medications" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_label" TEXT NULL, "amount_unknown" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("amount_unknown" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "stopped_at" INTEGER NULL, "removed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dose_schedules" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "medication_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medications (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "timing_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'anchor', "stopped_at" INTEGER NULL, "anchor" TEXT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "repeat" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_days" INTEGER NULL, "active_from" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fixed_timings" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "dose_schedule_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dose_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("dose_schedule_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dose_events" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "dose_schedule_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dose_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "routine_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "acted_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("dose_schedule_id", "routine_day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_backups" ("patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "wake_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "breakfast_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lunch_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dinner_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sleep_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "iftar_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "suhoor_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("patient_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_preferences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "elder_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("elder_mode" IN (0, 1)), "rung_first_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rung_first_on" IN (0, 1)), "rung_second_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rung_second_on" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emergency_profile" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "blood_type" TEXT NULL, "allergies" TEXT NULL, "chronic_conditions" TEXT NULL, "contacts_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "records" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "happened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "doctor" TEXT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "attachment_path" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "checkup_stage" INTEGER NULL, "fasting_reminder_at" INTEGER NULL, "checkup_stage_since" INTEGER NULL, "lab_booking_at" INTEGER NULL, "result_ready_at" INTEGER NULL, "doctor_visit_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "readings" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value_mg_dl" INTEGER NOT NULL, "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "context" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lab_results" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES records (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "test_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visit_questions" ("uuid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "patient_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "asked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("asked" IN (0, 1)));
